folders.title: Watched Folders
folders.modeDesc: Choose how Mouzi handles files in this folder.

archive.title: Import archive
archive.description: Pick a Google Takeout .zip, .tgz, or .tar.gz archive. Mouzi extracts it, flattens duplicate nested names safely, and runs your rules.

rules.title: Rules
rules.name: Name
rules.normalizeHelp: Map equivalent extensions before moving, for example jpeg:jpg. Separate mappings with commas.

history.title: History
history.confirmDescription: This only removes Mouzi's activity log. It does not move or delete your files.

general.title: General
general.gracePeriodDesc: Wait time before moving a file after it was last modified. 0 = instant.
general.checkFileLockDesc: Skip files currently in use by another process
general.autoUpdatesDesc: Check for new Mouzi versions and offer one-click installation.

ignore.title: Ignore
ignore.description: Choose a watched folder and set patterns for files Mouzi should skip. Patterns are saved as a .mouziignore file in that folder.
ignore.noRules: No ignore rules yet. Add one below.

about.title: About
about.description: Mouzi is a silent, elegant file organizer that lives in your system tray and keeps your Downloads folder (and any other folder) automatically tidy. It runs quietly in the background, monitors selected folders, and moves, renames, or sorts files based on customizable rules.
about.supportDesc: Your support keeps Mouzi improving. Thank you! 🙏

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.desc: Organize files automatically at scheduled times.

updater.current: You already have the latest version.
updater.error: Could not check for updates. Try again later.

beta.updaterDisabled: Automatic updates are disabled in this private beta. Install test builds manually.
beta.title: Mouzi 0.2.0 Beta
beta.notice: Private test build. Settings and history are separate from stable Mouzi. Use a test folder first; file operations affect real files.
beta.previewHelp: Review the matched rule and destination before applying. Nothing changes until you confirm. Suspicious filenames and Trash actions start unchecked.
beta.confirmHelp: Apply only the checked operations below? Trash actions can be restored through the system Trash.
beta.warning: This filename disguises an executable as another file type. Inspect it before approving. This is a filename warning, not an antivirus verdict.
beta.onlyNewHelp: Existing filenames are skipped while this is enabled, including after restart. Disable it to include the backlog. Enabling it again creates a new baseline.
beta.conditionHelp: All specified conditions must match. Leave a field empty for no limit.
beta.templateHelp: Use {stem}, {filename}, {extension}, {year}, {month}, {day}. Rename keeps the file in its current folder; collisions receive a numeric suffix.
beta.undoHelp: Restore the selected files to their original paths. Conflicting or changed files will be skipped with a result for each file.
beta.confirmClear: Delete all history? Files stay in place, but Mouzi will no longer be able to undo these operations.
beta.explorer: Add to Mouzi in Windows Explorer
beta.explorerHelp: Adds an optional folder context-menu entry. It opens a folder form for confirmation. On Windows 11 use Show more options. Disable this before moving or deleting the portable app.

validation.name: Enter a rule name.
validation.extensions: Enter valid extensions, or * for any file. Empty entries are discarded.
validation.pattern: Invalid regular expression. Check the pattern syntax.
validation.destination: Enter a destination without parent traversal (..).
validation.size: Minimum size must not exceed maximum size; use non-negative whole bytes.
validation.date: Enter a valid date range, with the start before the end.
validation.template: Use a filename template with supported placeholders and no path separators, invalid characters or reserved names.

errors.preview.locked: File is currently locked. Close the application using it and refresh.
errors.preview.expired: Preview expired or was already applied. Refresh it.
errors.preview.changed: The file, folder or rule changed. Refresh the preview.
errors.history.conflict: A file already exists at the original path. Nothing was overwritten.
errors.history.changed: The organized file has changed since the operation. It was not moved.
errors.history.unverified: This older operation has no verification record. Restore it manually.
